LanguageData.VREStarjack_CryostasisHediff.description: This person does not suffer fatal hypothermia. Instead, their bodies gradually slow down and enter a dormant state when exposed to extreme cold, and they can awaken safely once warmed.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_CryostasisHediff.label: cryostasis
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.description: This creature is suffering from oxygen toxicity caused by exposure to a breathable atmosphere. Their lungs cannot tolerate this much oxygen. They will die soon unless removed to a low-oxygen or vacuum environment.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.label: hyperoxia
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.0.label: initial
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.1.label: initial
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.2.label: mild
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.3.label: moderate
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.4.label: extreme
